target_note_title = "Bucket List"
target_item_text = "Witnessing a total solar eclipse"
def normalize_title(value):
    return " ".join(value.casefold().split())
matching_target_notes = [
    note for note in candidate_note_details

]
if len(matching_target_notes) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not uniquely identify the Bucket List note containing the requested item")
selected_note = matching_target_notes[0]
original_content = selected_note["content"]
content_lines = original_content.splitlines(keepends=True)
target_line_indexes = [
    index for index, line in enumerate(content_lines)
    if target_item_text.casefold() in line.casefold()
]
if len(target_line_indexes) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not uniquely identify the requested checklist line")
target_line_index = target_line_indexes[0]
raw_target_line = content_lines[target_line_index]
target_line_body = raw_target_line.rstrip("\r\n")
target_line_ending = raw_target_line[len(target_line_body):]
completed_markers = ("[x]", "[✓]", "☑", "☒", "✅")
already_done = any(marker.casefold() in target_line_body.casefold() for marker in completed_markers)
updated_target_line_body = target_line_body
if not already_done:
    unchecked_to_checked = (
        ("[ ]", "[x]"),
        ("[  ]", "[x]"),
        ("☐", "☑"),
        ("□", "☑"),
        ("⬜", "✅"),
        ("❌", "✅"),
    )
    applicable_markers = [(old, new) for old, new in unchecked_to_checked if old in target_line_body]
    if len(applicable_markers) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("The target line does not have one unambiguous supported unchecked marker")
    unchecked_marker, checked_marker = applicable_markers[0]
    updated_target_line_body = target_line_body.replace(unchecked_marker, checked_marker, 1)
content_lines[target_line_index] = updated_target_line_body + target_line_ending
